# Ethereum KZG proof verification vectors

`kzg-verify-proof.json` holds the 122 `verify_kzg_proof` cases (`kzg-mainnet`) of the Ethereum
consensus specification tests, converted from one YAML file per case to a single JSON file.
No value was changed: each case keeps its name, the hexadecimal `commitment`, `z`, `y` and
`proof` inputs (without the `0x` prefix) and its expected output (`true`, `false`, or `null`
for input the specification rejects).

- Fetched: 2026-11-27 from
  <https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/tree/a751e2d92abcd63b01d1400789789f5ea289a8b0/tests/verify_kzg_proof/kzg-mainnet>
  (commit `a751e2d92abcd63b01d1400789789f5ea289a8b0`).
- Origin: generated by the test generators of
  [ethereum/consensus-specs](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs), licence CC0-1.0. The copy
  fetched is the one kept in ethereum/c-kzg-4844 (Apache-2.0).
- SHA-256 of the JSON file: `1ce1b1d2dda4eb2d158f793c66f13925e1e126d550ea1ae69ba34a8bc4b593a0`.

Use: a test oracle for the KZG point evaluation precompile of the Lean EVM
(`formal/lean4/evm-cleanroom/scripts/precompiles/run-vectors.py`). It is test data only; no
implementation code was taken from either repository, and nothing here is shipped.
